formulas.ascii: D_k = beta_k tr((I - rho W)^-1)/n; T_k = beta_k 1'(I - rho W)^-1 1/n; indirect = T_k - D_k. Both inverses are the truncated series n + sum_{q=1..Q} (rho s)^q c_q with the stored powers of W/s (Horner), valid for |rho| s < 1; otherwise NaN, as for a failed fit.
